page_about.content:
NFC Deck Tracker helps trading card game (TCG) players build, organize, and track their decks, from preparation through to live play.

Using NFC (Near Field Communication), the app lets you scan a card to update your deck instantly, follow card usage during a game, and review deck statistics afterwards. The app works offline, and you can optionally sync your data across devices.

Developed by NsamaX as a thesis project at the Faculty of Science, Silpakorn University.

Version {version}

page_privacy.content:
Effective date: September 24, 2026

NFC Deck Tracker is a personal, non-commercial project. This policy explains what data the app uses and where it is stored.

1. Data on Your Device
Decks, collections, custom cards, game logs, and app settings are stored on your device.

2. Signing In with Google
Signing in is optional. When you sign in, your Google account ID and email address are processed by Firebase Authentication, a Google service. Your decks, collections, custom cards, and game logs are then synced to Cloud Firestore so they can be restored on other devices.

3. Custom Card Images
Images you add to custom cards are uploaded to Supabase cloud storage, whether or not you are signed in. Anyone who has an image's link can view it. Do not use images that contain personal information.

4. Sharing Game Logs
When you share a game log, the app shows a QR code that contains your account ID. Anyone who scans the code or knows your account ID can view the game log you shared most recently.

5. Card Search
Card searches for supported games are sent to that game's public card database.

6. Device Permissions
- NFC: to read and write card data on NFC tags.
- Camera: to scan QR codes only.
- Photos: to choose images for custom cards.

7. What the App Does Not Do
The app contains no advertising or analytics and does not sell your data.

8. Removing Your Data
Signing out removes your data from this device. The app cannot yet delete data stored in the cloud. If you do not want your decks and game logs stored online, use the app without signing in.

9. Changes to This Policy
This policy may be updated when the app changes. The effective date above identifies the current version.
